newsitem.title: USA: FCOJ futures called to open flat to 0.10 weaker.
newsitem.headline: FCOJ futures called to open flat to 0.10 weaker.

text.p: NYCE July frozen concentrated orange juice futures were called to open unchanged to 0.10 cent weaker Tuesday, based on market orders at 1005 EDT, dealers said.
Today is first notice day for the July contract.
Prices ended firmer but below highs Monday, with July closing up 0.20 cent at 72.55 cents a lb. Benchmark September settled 0.90 cent higher at 76.40 cents.
An estimated 5,000 lots changed hands on the day.
The market is expected to ease towards support pegged at 74.05 cents, followed by 72.00 cents for most-active September.
Volume should remain light for the rest of the week due to Friday's Fourth of July holiday.
